second_order: asking for help and showing how to make Eightfold
theme_note: These codes all recruit or enact the shared build: the post asks a small community for help and supplies the reference, placement method, area, and planned border; replies vary between volunteering and simply reporting that they are helping.

second_order: moving spots and keeping helpers updated
theme_note: These codes keep the attempt going as locations fail: they vary from attributing a takeover to Void and looking for new art, through posting new locations, to correcting a premature loss report and directing helpers to Discord.

second_order: working through running over Ghibli art
theme_note: These codes form two exchanges about overlapping Ghibli and Totoro art. Neighbours vary between documenting prior occupancy, softening blame, teasing, and yielding; the organizer varies between apologizing, explaining that Void will take the spot, and thanking someone who yields it.

second_order: working out borders with r/battlecats and r/Terraria
theme_note: These codes all work out how nearby drawings can fit. The Terraria comments ask for movement, compromise, and limits without a visible answer; the battlecats exchange checks a small clash, follows the group to its new location, trades plan images and clearances, and ends with thanks plus its own shortage of workers.

second_order: saying RIP and showing how close Eightfold got
theme_note: These codes look back after the attempt: the edited post says RIP, then a member asks for a picture from when it was alive and the organizer returns the closest screenshot. They vary between mourning words and preserving a visual trace.
